status: what has survived testing on a historical holdout, not what has been proven forward and not a profitability claim; no transaction cost, spread or funding is in any number here
highIsUnreachableFromBacktest: a badge never reads HIGH: every number here comes from a holdout, which is still a backtest. HIGH is reserved for a lane whose prospective forecasts have matured and held, which none has yet.
requirements: the task is binary: the sign of the forward return, with no FLAT class and no row converted into a direction
accuracy strictly above the test fold's own larger class
neither direction called on more than 80% of the test fold
a day-blocked bootstrap interval for the edge that excludes zero
above its own block majority in at least four of five chronological blocks
the test fold is after the training and validation folds in time, with an embargo of the feature window plus the horizon between them
conviction: a lane with a floor answers only when the model's probability is at least that far from even, and says it sees nothing otherwise. The floor is chosen on the validation fold and the gated lane is then measured once on the test fold, against the called rows' own majority. Coverage travels with every accuracy here: 'right more often on fewer bars' is only a result when both numbers are shown.

conviction.rule: the highest margin floor at which the model still speaks on at least one validation bar in 10, chosen on the validation fold alone and then measured once on the test fold
